gen-unbounded-gf-fragment-mono: Fragment Mono reads like nails on a ruler, a tall waist line and strokes with no shading to slow the eye. Unbounded's wide, friendly lettering is clearly the loudest voice on the page.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada reads tall and squared off, its high x-height giving each word a blocky woodblock stance. Vast Shadow does the showy, single-width lettering, while Anek Kannada keeps its terminals far from the stem.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-anek-latin: Vintage swagger up top, with tall, open lowercase letters running underneath it. Vast Shadow draws every line like a marker, while Anek Latin feels quieter beside it, nearly capital-tall.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-anek-odia: Rope-fine vintage lettering up top, with rounds below left unlatched like an open hook. Vast Shadow and Anek Odia agree on one thing: nothing here is crowded or sealed shut.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-anek-tamil: Vintage and eye-catching, Vast Shadow gives its downstrokes no extra weight, with space around each letter. Anek Tamil, with big round bowls, feels softer and more modern beside it.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-anuphan: Anuphan fills its lowercase with big round bowls and open curves, so lines of text never feel pinched. Beneath Vast Shadow's thread-like curves, paragraphs of it keep moving smoothly.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-armata: Armata reads spacious, with wide gaps between characters and lowercase bodies that fill most of the letter height. And under Vast Shadow's showy heading, whole paragraphs would drift past without a snag.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-athiti: Athiti keeps a see-through gap in each s and a high mean line. Vast Shadow does the showy, vintage lettering with single-width strokes, while Athiti handles the approachable, contemporary text.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-carrois-gothic: Modern from the first line, Carrois Gothic carries a high-set x-height and generously opened curves that never crowd. Under Vast Shadow's loud lettering, it would carry pages of text quietly.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-chocolate-classical-s: Chocolate Classical Sans has a sizable lowercase body and a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut. Vast Shadow makes a vintage entrance, then hands the text over to it.
